title: 香港金融占比26%：新加坡只有14%，税惠加码抢决策者
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Hong Kong and Singapore are two of the largest financial hubs in Asia.
segments.zh: 香港和新加坡是亚洲最大的两个金融中心。

segments.en: And they have a decades-long rivalry, especially when it comes to attracting the kind of people that decide where trillions of dollars get invested.
segments.zh: 它们之间的竞争已持续数十年，尤其是在吸引那些决定数万亿美元资金流向的人方面。

segments.en: And the latest battleground is taxes.
segments.zh: 最新的竞争领域是税收。

segments.en: The Hong Kong government says it plans to extend tax concessions given to family offices and funds.
segments.zh: 香港政府表示计划扩大给予家族办公室和基金的税收优惠。

segments.en: Singapore's failing a package of incentives to entice asset managers.
segments.zh: 新加坡正在推出一系列激励措施来吸引资管机构。

segments.en: Both governments want as to attract key decision makers.
segments.zh: 两地政府都希望吸引关键决策者。

segments.en: For some, that could potentially mean tens of millions of dollars every year going directly into their own pockets.
segments.zh: 对一些人来说，这可能意味着每年数千万美元直接进入他们的口袋。

segments.en: The hope is these tax breaks will boost the financial sector.
segments.zh: 希望这些税收减免能提振金融业。

segments.en: In Hong Kong, the finance sector generates about 26% of GDP.
Compared to about 14% in Singapore, both have assets under management of over five trillion US dollars right now.
segments.zh: 相比之下新加坡约为14%，目前两地的资管规模均超过5万亿美元。

segments.en: This story is about the latest race between Singapore and Hong Kong to become Asia's leading financial hub.
segments.zh: 本期讲述新加坡与香港争夺亚洲领先金融中心的最新竞争。

segments.en: It will bring more money flow into the city, but also more job opportunities, creating more economic growth for both regions.
segments.zh: 这将为城市带来更多资金流入，也创造更多就业机会，推动两地经济增长。

segments.en: We are going to put together a bill for legislative approval to extend the tax concessions that we give to family offices and funds.
segments.zh: 我们将提交法案供立法会批准，以延长对家族办公室和基金的税收优惠。
